scripts.dev: npm run build -w @planner/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @planner/server" "npm run dev -w @planner/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @planner/shared && npm run build -w @planner/server && npm run build -w @planner/web
scripts.db:clear:docker: docker compose exec planner node scripts/clear-db.mjs /data/app.db
